name: additional deformation of rails
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 由基础沉降等外部几何变化传递形成的钢轨变形。
usage_overview: 在利用车辆响应研究路基沉降影响时，钢轨附加变形作为沉降传递至钢轨后的附加几何激励，用于分析沉降对车辆—轨道系统的影响，并研究路基沉降阈值。

complete_examples.text: In this paper, the additional deformation of rails is regarded as the additional track irregularity excitation in wheel-rail interaction.
The low-frequency components of vehicle responses induced by the additional deformation of rails are extracted by Wavelet decomposition.

P083.title: Study on the long-distance settlement threshold of high-speed railway subgrade based on vehicle responses
P083.authors: Z Li, W Wang, L Xu, J Xu
P083.label: Li等（2024）

contexts.text: 路基沉降传递至钢轨后产生的变形，被作为附加几何激励。
